feature: Mobile Inspector media picker meets the 44px touch-target contract

finding.reproduction: Real Chromium at a 390px viewport measured the shared Inspector media picker open button at 38px and its revealed search input at 38.89px, below the canonical plan 44px mobile touch target.
finding.impact: Selecting or searching for an Inspector media asset required a smaller touch target than the plan promises, making the responsive Inspector harder to operate on touch screens.
finding.fix: A max-width:850px rule now follows the shared media-picker base rules and raises the open button and search input min-height to 44px. The editor-refresh stylesheet URL version was bumped so clients fetch the updated asset.
finding.reuse_review: The existing shared mediaAssetPicker and project-owned responsive stylesheet remain in use. No external code, dependency, or new infrastructure was needed.
